description: Fix: Editor displays JSON parse error when loading file because Vite dev server returns HTML instead of proxying /api/* requests to the Fastify API

userStories.title: Add Vite proxy for /api in vite.config.ts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Vite dev server to proxy all /api/* requests to http://localhost:3001 so that fetch calls from the web app reach the Fastify API instead of receiving the SPA fallback HTML.
acceptanceCriteria: In apps/web/vite.config.ts, add server.proxy with '/api' targeting 'http://localhost:3001' and changeOrigin: true
The existing server.port: 5173 setting is preserved
No other settings in vite.config.ts are changed
userStories.notes: Added server.proxy '/api' -> http://localhost:3001 with changeOrigin:true. Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: Guard content-type and normalize errors in useFileLoader
userStories.description: As a user, I want the editor to show a friendly, actionable error message when the API is unavailable or returns an unexpected response, instead of a raw SyntaxError leaking from the JS engine.
acceptanceCriteria: In apps/web/src/hooks/useFileLoader.ts, after confirming res.ok === true, check that res.headers.get('content-type') includes 'application/json'
If content-type does not include 'application/json' and res.ok === true, throw new Error('Resposta inesperada do servidor (não-JSON)')
In the catch block, map TypeError and SyntaxError to the message 'Não foi possível carregar o arquivo. Verifique se a API está em execução.'
Non-TypeError/SyntaxError errors that are instanceof Error continue using err.message; fallback is 'Erro desconhecido'
AbortError handling is preserved — early return without setting error state
Errors from res.ok === false (HTTP error responses) continue using body.error or 'HTTP <status>' as message
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added content-type guard (throws non-JSON error when res.ok but not application/json). Catch block now maps TypeError/SyntaxError to friendly PT-BR message; AbortError preserved; typecheck passes.
